note: What each route's start ships: a real browser lists the files a first load fetches (scripts/budgets/list.mjs), and each counts at the bytes the hub sends for it, from the build (measure.mjs; response headers not counted). `mise run budgets`, the `budgets` job of check.yml. A change may grow a route by its allowance over its merge-base and may never take it past its ceiling. The check reads these limits from the merge-base, never from the change, so raising one, or dropping a route, is its own commit, with the owner's yes: docs/context/quality.md#budgets-check. Every limit is PROPOSED until the owner confirms it: they were set from the data below, not by the owner. allowance 500 B: the 20 newest commits that touched web/ or scripts/web-dist (11-12 to 11-13), each built and listed by the browser on its parent and itself, grew home by -40 to +356 B each (median +19 B, 90th percentile +181 B), +1,169 B in all. Each ceiling is what the route ships on the merge-base this was written on (a1dc2448: home, search, library/albums and now 328,750 B, settings/playback 331,840 B) + 1,000 B, the room the Lighthouse budgets (tests/ui/budgets.json) keep over main today; those are Lighthouse's own figures, which count response headers and the hub's covers.

allowance.why: Room for an ordinary change: 20 of the last 20 web commits grew a start by 356 B or less, and too little for a script, a font or a stylesheet to slip into the start. Growth beyond it goes to the owner with an impact note.

ceiling.why: What home's start ships on a1dc2448 (328,750 B) + 1,000 B, as tests/ui/budgets.json keeps room over main. Home, Search and Now Playing are the shell and the start's scripts; their own screens' code is part of it.
What search's start ships on a1dc2448 (328,750 B) + 1,000 B: the same files as home.
What library/albums' start ships on a1dc2448 (328,750 B) + 1,000 B. Its album covers (about 16 KB in Lighthouse's runs) are the hub's answers, not files of the build, and aren't counted.
What now's start ships on a1dc2448 (328,750 B) + 1,000 B: the same files as home.
What settings/playback's start ships on a1dc2448 (331,840 B) + 1,000 B: home's files plus Settings' own code (screens/settings-fit.js and the equaliser's screens/eq.js).
